What this model represents

An independent, simplified closed-loop teaching prototype; not calibrated or validated against SimBioSys. Sympathetic and parasympathetic feedback can be frozen independently. Parasympathetic feedback affects heart rate only in this simplified model; its gain is provisional. No patient predictions. Severe volume loss can exceed its useful physiological range.

Waveforms and PV loops come from integrated model states. Dashed overlays on all three plots show a separately simulated healthy baseline; they do not change with the experiment.

Guyton curves are an idealized relationship calculated from current model parameters, not measured patient curves. Filling pressures are intravascular; ventricular distending pressure also depends on external pericardial pressure.
